run_clm_prompt_evaluation: run the CLM prompt evaluation script with a specified model and dataset using argparse CLI
generate_text_with_model: generate text completions from a list of prompts using the Model class generate method
load_model_with_int8: load a pretrained causal language model like GPT-Neo or OPT and convert it to int8 on GPU
normalize_answer_text: normalize answer text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
calc_accuracy_for_predictions: calculate exact match accuracy between model predictions and reference answers with optional ngram grouping
